milestones.name: Defeat Gruz Mother
milestones.note: Mini-boss in Forgotten Crossroads; killing her spawns small Gruz that must also be killed to open the gates

milestones.name: Meet Sly
milestones.note: Speak with Sly in his little house; he then opens a shop back at Dirtmouth

milestones.name: Rescue Grub (downward parry passage)
milestones.note: Requires downward parry strikes; found by dropping down a passage to the left about halfway up the tall rock-platform room

milestones.name: Rescue Grub (shielded-bug wall)
milestones.note: Found behind a breakable wall to the left after defeating two nail-and-shield bugs

milestones.name: Activate Stag Station
milestones.note: Rest at the bench and pay the fee to activate the Stag Station in Forgotten Crossroads; enables fast travel

milestones.name: Defeat False Knight
milestones.note: Boss of Forgotten Crossroads; falls three times before dying; drops City Crest

milestones.name: Obtain City Crest
milestones.note: Picked up after hitting False Knight's head one last time after he falls into the pit

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Underground crossroads area with rock platforms, stag station, Soul Totem, Gruz Mother arena, False Knight arena

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Surface town; Sly opens his shop here after being met; referred to as Dartmouth in the text but consistent context confirms Dirtmouth
zones.note: Text spells it 'Dartmouth' but context confirms this is Dirtmouth

abilities.name: Downward Parry Strike
abilities.note: Player is advised to practice this skill to rescue the Grub in the spike passage

abilities.name: City Crest
abilities.grants: Unknown progression unlock (used in City of Tears area)
abilities.note: Dropped by the False Knight; picked up after the killing blow to his head

bosses.name: Gruz Mother
bosses.note: Mini-boss; two attacks: darting charge and fast bounce; death spawns small Gruz that must be cleared to open gates

bosses.name: False Knight
bosses.note: Main boss; slow but powerful mace attacks including shockwave and jump-smash; defeated after being knocked down three times; drops City Crest
